questions.question: In what year was the University of Notre Dame founded?
questions.learn: Notre Dame began on November 26, 1842, when Rev. Edward Sorin, C.S.C., and seven Holy Cross companions arrived in northern Indiana.

questions.question: Who founded the University of Notre Dame?
questions.learn: Rev. Edward Sorin, C.S.C., founded Notre Dame in 1842.

questions.question: What year did Notre Dame football begin?
questions.learn: Notre Dame football began in 1887.

questions.question: Which school played Notre Dame in its first football game?
questions.learn: Michigan traveled to South Bend for Notre Dame's first football game on Nov. 23, 1887.

questions.question: In what year was Notre Dame officially chartered by the Indiana legislature?

questions.question: What was the score of Notre Dame's first football game in 1887?
